files.scene: Fox and rabbit lie on backs on snow making two snow angels with broad outlined wing-shaped impressions; correct four limbs per mammal
Bear and deer walk beside an unfrozen woodland lake viewed from the safe snowy bank, big pine tree, rounded mountains
Rabbit waits at bottom of a gentle sledding hill while penguin rides a sled toward them, distinct from single fox sled page
Fox stands outside a little snowy forest cabin carrying one log, one round window and chimney, two rounded pines
Deer and rabbit investigate a trail of large simple paw prints in snow using one magnifying glass
Bear holds one large mug of hot cocoa at a small table by a snowy window, scarf on chair, plate with two cookies
Fox and penguin enjoy a winter picnic on a broad blanket, thermos and two cups with one bread roll each, no Christmas props
Bear and rabbit build a small snow-block fort with three large lower blocks and two upper blocks, one toy shovel
Deer decorates a long winter scarf laid across a low table using three simple sewn patches: circle star heart, no sharp sewing tools
Penguin and fox finish a small igloo made of big simple outlined snow blocks, open arched doorway and one shovel
Rabbit and bear ride a short cheerful winter train in two open carriages; engine with round wheels, snowy hill behind
Fox and deer play gently tossing one large soft snowball between them, two little snowball piles on ground
Rabbit walks under large simple falling snowflakes carrying a wide open umbrella with clearly visible handle
Bear and penguin watch three broad outlined ribbons of northern lights from a snowy hill, crescent moon and few big stars, no dark sky fill
Fox curls on a broad window seat with one blanket and a mug on a separate side table, snowy pine outside, quiet winter evening
